text:
Derek H: Heads-up — bringing up yvr-gpu-cluster next Tue 09:00 PT. Networking bring-up checklist below, need folks for validation + handoff. TL;DR: transit attachment, NAT/egress IPs, DNS delegation, route propagation, firewall allowlist. Please confirm you can take each item.

Mia (eng-infra): I can own the Transit/GW attachment and route tables. Plan: attach the new VPCs to north-america-tgw in us-west-2, enable route propagation to the VPC route tables, and create explicit routes for the GPU subnets to the TGW attachment. @Derek H, confirm TGW choice.

Samira K: I'll do NAT/Egress. Recommendation: 2 NAT Gateways (multi-AZ) with 3 EIPs for HA and for allowlisting. Will reserve EIPs and post the IPs here before handoff. Quick cost note: TGW + inter-region transit traffic charges apply if we route cross-region, estimate ~ $0.03/GB on top of NAT fees — will put rough numbers in the runbook.

Anish P: DNS: create a private hosted zone yvr.internal.redwood.com under the infra account, then delegate from the organization parent zone. Add records for gpu-proxy.{yvr.internal.redwood.com} and registry-cache.{yvr.internal.redwood.com}. Also provision Route53 Resolver endpoints for cross-account resolution and add inbound rules for onprem resolver IPs.

Carla: Validation volunteers: I can run the smoke tests after networking says ready. I need the egress IP list, expected DNS names, and the registry IP to validate container pulls. Also please list NTP/OS update allowlist IPs.

OpsBot: Deploy job scheduled: infra-deploy/yvr-gpu-cluster at 2026-03-24T09:00Z. Will post status updates in this thread.

Derek H: Minimal route snippet we'll apply in VPC route table (example):
```
resource "aws_route" "to_tgw" {
  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.private_rt.id
  destination_cidr_block = "10.0.0.0/8"  # internal overlay range
  transit_gateway_id     = data.aws_ec2_transit_gateway.main.id
}
```
Make sure route_table_id is the private RT used by worker subnets; do NOT modify the public RTs.

Mia (eng-infra): Routing notes: enable propagation from TGW attachment and verify with `aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-route-table-entries`. If using Direct Connect to onprem, confirm BGP communities and that we are not leaking 100.64.0.0/10 into public tables. Also confirm no conflicting local routes for 10.0.0.0/8.

Samira K: NAT config checklist:
- Create 2 NAT Gateways in separate AZs
- Attach Elastic IPs and tag as `env:yvr-gpu`
- Add default route 0.0.0.0/0 -> NAT GW in private route tables (per AZ)
- Setup CloudWatch health metric alarms for NAT failure and Lambda to failover if both NATs unhealthy
Security groups: workers only need outbound 443 and 123 (NTP); deny inbound except necessary management ports from bastion.

Anish P: DNS delegation steps: 1) create private zone yvr.internal.redwood.com in infra account, 2) create NS records in parent zone redwood.internal for the delegation, 3) create Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint in infra account and outbound endpoints in aggregator account, 4) attach resolver rules to the VPCs. Also add conditional forwarders for onprem.

Derek H: Handoff checklist (must be completed before tagging runbook `networking:ready`):
1) TGW attachment shows `available` and routes propagated to all worker RTs
2) Traceroute from a worker IP to registry-cache.{yvr.internal.redwood.com} resolves and stays within internal path
3) Container image pull from registry succeeds (test image: redwood/alpine:3.18)
4) Egress IPs published to security team for allowlisting
5) DNS records exist and TTLs are sane (<= 60s for initial bring-up)
6) Monitoring dashboards for NAT and TGW attached to the cluster team
7) Costs estimated and added to PRD (TGW attachments, NAT gateways, EIPs)

Carla: I'll run 1-3 once you post the `networking:ready` tag. Please post the final EIP list and the resolver endpoints.

Mia (eng-infra): Quick validation commands I'll use post-attach: `aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-attachments --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=<vpc-id>` and `aws route53resolver list-resolver-endpoints`. Will also run `traceroute` and `dig @<resolver-ip> gpu-proxy.yvr.internal.redwood.com` and paste outputs.

Samira K: Note on egress costs & sizing: if we see sustained registry pulls during rollouts, consider temporary use of a cross-region cache and rate-limit CI/CD bursts. TGW data path can inflate costs if we route a lot of build traffic between regions.

Derek H: Assigning tasks: Mia -> TGW & route propagation; Samira -> NAT/EIPs & security groups; Anish -> DNS + resolver; Carla -> validation tests; I'll do final signoff and create the PagerDuty handover to eng-oncall once `networking:ready`.

Carla: Copy that. I'll be oncall Tue 09-11 PT for verification.

Mia (eng-infra): Starting the TGW attachment today, will post attachment-id and propagation screenshots here.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-24T08:30Z runbook pre-check triggered.

Derek H: Thanks all — please try to avoid large infra changes in the 2 hours before 09:00 PT. Post questions here. :thumbsup:
